test_coverage.server_backed_action_create: Through Actions Workbench UI, SUP creates a real Action using a readable current Issue from the server reference catalog, a project contractor participant, the current server scope, a title, and a due date.
assertions: Server creation capability is available to SUP and denied to OWN.
Create response and subsequent workspace read preserve status draft, exact relatedIssueId, server-derived correctionCycle, selected responsiblePartyId, and version 1.
The create response and workspace audit contain one create:action event in draft state.
No assign/start/other workflow command is issued during creation or while switching ko/vi/en.
Unsaved form values survive locale changes without API mutation.
Explicit Create another Action reset clears the draft form without another write and permits entry of the next draft.
OWN's server-denied create affordance is disabled and sends no create request.
